cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Luxury Watch & Jewelry 360-Degree Macro Turntable evaluation (locking 0.05mm Swiss dial typography, 4Hz tourbillon gear-ratio kinematics, and 57-facet brilliant-cut diamond normals, tracing 6-bounce total internal reflection with Cauchy 6-band spectral dispersion [IOR=2.417, Abbe v=55.3] and tangent-space anisotropic GGX gold highlights, and projecting refracted photon caustics onto AI-synthesized velvet/marble pedestals so amortized per-SKU cost c_lux(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_lux = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive unconstrained I2V generation (which melts 0.2mm tachymeter numerals and flattens diamond fire into dull plastic, inflating reshoot cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-band spectral facet quadrature.
